places.name: Pécs Cathedral & Cathedral Terrace
places.ai_summary: A stunning cathedral with a terrace offering panoramic views of Pécs, showcasing Romanesque architecture and rich history.
places.place_tip: Climb the terrace for the best views of the city.

places.name: Early Christian Necropolis (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring ancient burial chambers and frescoes, offering a glimpse into early Christian history.
places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the frescoes.

places.name: Zsolnay Cultural Quarter
places.ai_summary: A vibrant cultural hub featuring museums, galleries, and workshops dedicated to the famous Zsolnay ceramics.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Zsolnay Fountain and the Eosin exhibits.

places.ai_summary: A historic mosque turned church, showcasing Ottoman architecture and a blend of cultural influences.
places.place_tip: Admire the intricate Ottoman designs inside.

places.name: Kossuth Square & Széchenyi Square
places.ai_summary: The central squares of Pécs, surrounded by historic buildings, cafes, and a lively atmosphere.
places.place_tip: Enjoy the street performances and local markets.

places.name: Zsolnay Fountain
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and iconic fountain located in the Zsolnay Cultural Quarter, known for its unique design and vibrant colors.
places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the tranquility.

places.name: TV Tower (Misina Peak) Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint in Pécs, offering stunning panoramic views of the city and the surrounding countryside.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

places.name: Jakovali Hassan Mosque & Museum
places.ai_summary: A historic mosque and museum, offering insight into the Islamic heritage of Pécs and beautiful examples of Ottoman architecture.
places.place_tip: Respect the dress code when visiting.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful synagogue in Pécs, showcasing stunning stained glass windows and intricate interior designs.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history.

places.place_tip: Great spot for a picnic with a view.

places.ai_summary: The remnants of the ancient city walls of Pécs, offering a glimpse into the city's historical fortifications.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Tettye Ruins.

places.ai_summary: The treasury of the Pécs Cathedral, housing a collection of valuable religious artifacts and the famous Golden Cross.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Golden Cross and the liturgical vestments.

places.name: Nick-Dráva Wine Shop Street
places.ai_summary: A charming street in Pécs known for its wine shops and tasting rooms, offering a variety of local wines.
places.place_tip: Visit multiple shops for a variety of tastings.
places.address: Nick-Dráva Wine Shop Street, Pécs, Hungary

places.name: Zsolnay Mausoleum
places.ai_summary: The mausoleum of the Zsolnay family, featuring unique architecture and beautiful ceramic decorations.
places.place_tip: Admire the ceramic details on the mausoleum.
